Sense into the new area (or continue using the old). See if there is anything different at each step. Does the body want any contact, space, words, other care? Let the mental image go, sense your body, sense your contact points, come back.

name: Prepare the workshop (time, place, tools, boundaries, etc)....
text: Prepare the workshop (time, place, tools, boundaries, etc). Invite the signal/feeling/young part to come only as close as is welcome. Try to avoid any language that makes you feel you’re not one person. Care for it as best you can, by asking what it wants and giving that if you can, or sensing into it and responding, or just being with it. Take breaks, get back in contact if that’s ok, take more breaks, etc. Keep bringing in adult functions (or borrow someone else’s function). Have the adult part of you run the show. The goal is to make it “good as you” rather than “good as new”, not to erase history. Tell your little one, “That’s enough for today. We’re going back to the life we’re building.” Close the workspace, reassure yourself that you are one whole person, that you’re an adult now, and come back.

name: Pick a resource quality you understand (warmth, boundary, st...
text: Pick a resource quality you understand (warmth, boundary, steadiness, curiosity, or dignity). Imagine yourself accessing 1% more of that quality (or, if you prefer, just observe it rather than embody it). What is different? How is your body, voice, etc? Do this a few times to strengthen it. Come back, keeping the quality and a positive action that you would do with it, but leaving the imagined you behind, saying “I am me”.

name: Chapter 7 of Trauma and Memory, by Peter Levine, 2015, is us...
text: Chapter 7 of Trauma and Memory, by Peter Levine, 2015, is useful on the difference between compelling experience and historical verification. This US Department of Veterans Affairs website contains useful general information about hypnosis, such as the fact that it can be very strong and should be carefully used, and that it may result in false memories. This ASCH website contains information about the usefulness of getting certified in hypnosis, and why it doesn’t guarantee competence. Links are available for these and other useful groups in the evidence and specialist sections, but they point to their particular claims rather than validating every use of hypnosis.
